operations.edit: target, expected_revision, text; optional assets on own draft/post
operations.send_dm: target observed incoming DM, text; delivered only to that sender
operations.set_record: target private record, expected_revision, fields object; values must fit its visible field_schema

tool_protocol.call_format: One JSON object with top-level action and parameters, using the displayed tools and operations.
tool_protocol.budgets: Every call, including WAIT, FINISH and invalid calls, consumes one calls unit. A successful READ or ASK consumes one reads or asks unit per call, not per ID/topic. COMMIT consumes one writes unit per operation, within writes_per_commit; failed atomic commits do not consume writes.
tool_protocol.clock: READ, ASK, COMMIT and CHECK act at the current time, then advance the clock by one minute, capped at the deadline. Invalid calls also consume one minute unless the episode has ended. COMMIT effects and snapshots use the action start time; the returned observation is after this advance. The deadline or exhausted call budget freezes the episode.
tool_protocol.READ: ids must contain 1–3 currently available resource IDs. New resource notifications expose an index; use READ for their full contents. Own editable content is already observed.
tool_protocol.ASK: topics must contain 1–3 distinct published topic IDs, each not previously asked, with a nonempty question. Answers arrive after 5 simulated minutes and then require READ. A request whose answer would arrive at or after the deadline is rejected.
tool_protocol.COMMIT: operations is a list applied atomically; it does not manually jump to the next stage. Scheduled stages/events follow the clock rules. Editable objects require their current integer expected_revision; revisions increase on edits. Replies and DMs require a READ target in the correct channel. set_record uses only visible field_schema values. A private handoff is optional and may be empty; it does not perform external actions.
tool_protocol.text_limits: Authored edit, reply, DM, ASK question, CHECK reason and FINISH handoff text must be nonempty and at most 4000 characters. COMMIT handoff may be empty but is also limited to 4000 characters.
tool_protocol.WAIT: time must be a future integer no later than the deadline. WAIT advances to that time or wakes earlier for a new resource or scheduled reminder; it does not add another minute after waking.
tool_protocol.CHECK: time must be a future integer no later than the deadline, with a nonempty reason. At most six active reminders are allowed; CHECK itself takes one minute.
tool_protocol.FINISH: A nonempty private handoff ends work immediately with zero simulated minutes. Early finish does not cancel existing task obligations or turn a handoff into a public delivery.
